metric_definitions.profit_factor: Gross positive trade P&L / absolute gross negative trade P&L, matching Phase 13. Net PF is separately supplied.
metric_definitions.wins_losses: Based on net trade P&L; average_loss is a positive loss magnitude.
metric_definitions.drawdown: Realized closed-trade equity only; no intrabar mark-to-market. Slices carry actual starting capital and reset the local peak at slice start.
metric_definitions.triggers: Number of sessions in which the loss latch is reached or fifth trade opens, not repeated blocked-bar log messages; counts can overlap.
metric_definitions.signals: Calls actually made by the unchanged runner, after position, risk, cutoff and readiness gates; HOLD is not every strategy bar.
metric_definitions.exposure: Modeled stop fill including adverse exit slippage and charges / capital before entry. Gaps can exceed it. Occupied bars include entry and exit bars and are a coarse duration proxy.
metric_definitions.slices: Trade attribution from the two single full-history runs; no strategy or capital resets and no optimization.
